text: To make them come in useful, there are lots of ways and means. For instance, when our Jimmy goes out fishing with a tin, they'll do the stick up on his rod to take the piddlers in. Old mother leaves. She didn't care a thing for none of these. When she won his costume, all she did was shake the cream. Some are blousy, some are blousy, and they tell me that they're great.
